paragraphs.en: Open-source, self-hostable deployment platform with built-in CI/CD. Point it at a repo — it builds, ships, routes, and TLS-terminates your app. Drive it from a desktop app, web dashboard, or CLI.
paragraphs.zh: 开源、可自托管的部署平台，内置 CI/CD。 将其指向一个代码仓库——它就会为你的应用进行构建、发布、路由和 TLS 终结。 可通过桌面应用、网页控制台或命令行工具来操控它。

sents.en: Open-source, self-hostable deployment platform with built-in CI/CD.
sents.zh: 开源、可自托管的部署平台，内置 CI/CD。

sents.en: Point it at a repo — it builds, ships, routes, and TLS-terminates your app.
sents.zh: 将其指向一个代码仓库——它就会为你的应用进行构建、发布、路由和 TLS 终结。

sents.en: Drive it from a desktop app, web dashboard, or CLI.
sents.zh: 可通过桌面应用、网页控制台或命令行工具来操控它。

paragraphs.en: Quick Start · How It Works · Interfaces · Docs · Contributing
paragraphs.zh: 快速开始 · 工作原理 · 接口 · 文档 · 参与贡献

paragraphs.en: There's one decision to make first: how you run Openship itself (the control plane). Everything else is the same afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 首先需要做一个决定：你如何运行 Openship 本身（控制平面）。 之后其他一切都一样。

sents.en: There's one decision to make first: how you run Openship itself (the control plane).
sents.zh: 首先需要做一个决定：你如何运行 Openship 本身（控制平面）。

sents.en: Everything else is the same afterwards.
sents.zh: 之后其他一切都一样。

paragraphs.en: Solo? Use the desktop app. It runs Openship's control plane on your own machine only while the app is open — nothing is left running on an always-on server, nothing is exposed publicly. You only need an always-on server install once you want push-to-deploy (CI/CD) , team access , or to host apps on that box — the things that need a public, always-on endpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 单人使用？请用桌面应用。 它仅在应用打开时在你自己的机器上运行 Openship 的控制平面——常驻服务器上不会留下任何运行中的东西，也不会向公网暴露任何内容。 只有当你需要推送部署（CI/CD）、团队访问，或想在这台机器上托管应用时——也就是需要公网常驻端点的那些功能——你才需要安装一个常驻服务器。

sents.en: Solo? Use the desktop app.
sents.zh: 单人使用？请用桌面应用。

sents.en: It runs Openship's control plane on your own machine only while the app is open — nothing is left running on an always-on server, nothing is exposed publicly.
sents.zh: 它仅在应用打开时在你自己的机器上运行 Openship 的控制平面——常驻服务器上不会留下任何运行中的东西，也不会向公网暴露任何内容。

sents.en: You only need an always-on server install once you want push-to-deploy (CI/CD) , team access , or to host apps on that box — the things that need a public, always-on endpoint.
sents.zh: 只有当你需要推送部署（CI/CD）、团队访问，或想在这台机器上托管应用时——也就是需要公网常驻端点的那些功能——你才需要安装一个常驻服务器。

paragraphs.en: The control plane runs locally and drives your servers over SSH. No login, no terminal, no public surface — download, open, done:
paragraphs.zh: 控制平面在本地运行，并通过 SSH 驱动你的服务器。 无需登录、无需终端、无公开暴露面——下载、打开、即完成：

sents.en: The control plane runs locally and drives your servers over SSH.
sents.zh: 控制平面在本地运行，并通过 SSH 驱动你的服务器。

sents.en: No login, no terminal, no public surface — download, open, done:
sents.zh: 无需登录、无需终端、无公开暴露面——下载、打开、即完成：

paragraphs.en: Linux: chmod +x Openship.AppImage && ./Openship.AppImage . Already have the CLI? openship install fetches and launches it. Links always point at the newest release.
paragraphs.zh: Linux: chmod +x Openship.AppImage && ./Openship.AppImage 。 已经有 CLI 了吗？openship install 会获取并启动它。 链接始终指向最新版本。

sents.en: Linux: chmod +x Openship.AppImage && ./Openship.AppImage .
sents.zh: Linux: chmod +x Openship.AppImage && ./Openship.AppImage 。

sents.en: Already have the CLI? openship install fetches and launches it.
sents.zh: 已经有 CLI 了吗？openship install 会获取并启动它。

sents.en: Links always point at the newest release.
sents.zh: 链接始终指向最新版本。

paragraphs.en: From the desktop app you connect a server (SSH) or Openship Cloud and deploy to it — the app itself doesn't host public apps on your laptop.
paragraphs.zh: 通过桌面应用，你可以连接一台服务器（SSH）或 Openship Cloud 并将应用部署到其上——该应用本身不会在你的笔记本电脑上托管公开应用。

paragraphs.en: Install the CLI (it bundles the API + dashboard), then run openship — an interactive wizard creates the first admin, wires your domain, and installs Openship as a boot service. Run it again anytime to manage the instance.
paragraphs.zh: 安装 CLI（它捆绑了 API 和仪表板），然后运行 openship —— 一个交互式向导会创建第一个管理员、配置你的域名，并将 Openship 安装为开机自启服务。 之后可随时再次运行它来管理该实例。

sents.en: Install the CLI (it bundles the API + dashboard), then run openship — an interactive wizard creates the first admin, wires your domain, and installs Openship as a boot service.
sents.zh: 安装 CLI（它捆绑了 API 和仪表板），然后运行 openship —— 一个交互式向导会创建第一个管理员、配置你的域名，并将 Openship 安装为开机自启服务。

sents.en: Run it again anytime to manage the instance.
sents.zh: 之后可随时再次运行它来管理该实例。

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io | sh # install (or: npm i -g openship — needs Node 22+) openship # guided setup, then control panel The install script brings its own Node when your system one is older than 22; a package-manager install runs on the Node you already have.
paragraphs.zh:
curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io | sh # 安装（或：npm i -g openship — 需要 Node 22+）
openship # 引导式设置，然后进入控制面板

如果你的系统 Node 版本低于 22，安装脚本会自带一个 Node；通过包管理器安装则使用你已有的 Node 运行。

paragraphs.en: For CI / headless boxes, skip the wizard and drive openship up directly:
paragraphs.zh: 对于 CI / 无头（headless）机器，可跳过向导，直接驱动 openship：

paragraphs.en: openship up # install + start as a background service (boots + auto-restarts) openship up --public-url https://openship.example.com # + serve the dashboard on your domain (edge + TLS handled) openship up picks how it runs for you:
paragraphs.zh: openship up # 安装并作为后台服务启动（开机自启 + 自动重启） openship up --public-url https://openship.example.com # + 在你的域名上提供仪表盘服务（边缘节点 + TLS 已自动处理） openship up 会自动为你选择运行方式：

paragraphs.en: A self-hosted instance always requires login (the admin you create in setup). openship open opens the dashboard · openship stop stops it · openship update upgrades · openship up --foreground runs attached.
paragraphs.zh: 自托管实例始终需要登录（即你在安装时创建的管理员）。openship open 打开控制面板 · openship stop 停止它 · openship update 升级 · openship up --foreground 前台附加运行。

paragraphs.en: Preview an unreleased build (dev). To run the CLI built straight from source — a branch, tag, or main ahead of the next release — install the from-source build:
paragraphs.zh: 预览未发布的构建版本（dev）。 要运行直接从源码构建的 CLI——即分支、标签或领先于下一个发布版本的主分支——请安装从源码构建的版本：

sents.en: Preview an unreleased build (dev).
sents.zh: 预览未发布的构建版本（dev）。

sents.en: To run the CLI built straight from source — a branch, tag, or main ahead of the next release — install the from-source build:
sents.zh: 要运行直接从源码构建的 CLI——即分支、标签或领先于下一个发布版本的主分支——请安装从源码构建的版本：

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | sh # main (default) curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | OPENSHIP_REF=dev sh # a branch/tag (var goes on sh, not curl) openship-dev # same CLI, built from source openship-dev update # pull latest source + rebuild (no release needed) It installs as a separate openship-dev command with its own isolated home ( ~/.openship-dev ) and boot service, so your production openship and its data are never touched. Needs Bun + git; it's an unverified dev build (the dashboard compile wants real RAM/CPU) — not a production path.
paragraphs.zh: curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | sh # 主分支（默认） curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | OPENSHIP_REF=dev sh # 某个分支/标签（变量放在 sh 后面，而不是 curl 后面） openship-dev # 同一个命令行工具，从源码构建 openship-dev update # 拉取最新源码并重新构建（无需发布版本） 它会安装为一个独立的 openship-dev 命令，拥有自己隔离的主目录（ ~/.openship-dev ）和启动服务，因此你的生产环境 openship 及其数据绝不会受到影响。 需要 Bun 和 git；这是一个未经校验的开发版本（仪表盘编译需要足够的内存和 CPU 性能）——并非生产环境方案。

sents.en: curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | sh # main (default) curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | OPENSHIP_REF=dev sh # a branch/tag (var goes on sh, not curl) openship-dev # same CLI, built from source openship-dev update # pull latest source + rebuild (no release needed) It installs as a separate openship-dev command with its own isolated home ( ~/.openship-dev ) and boot service, so your production openship and its data are never touched.
sents.zh: curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | sh # 主分支（默认） curl -fsSL https://get.openship.io/dev | OPENSHIP_REF=dev sh # 某个分支/标签（变量放在 sh 后面，而不是 curl 后面） openship-dev # 同一个命令行工具，从源码构建 openship-dev update # 拉取最新源码并重新构建（无需发布版本） 它会安装为一个独立的 openship-dev 命令，拥有自己隔离的主目录（ ~/.openship-dev ）和启动服务，因此你的生产环境 openship 及其数据绝不会受到影响。

sents.en: Needs Bun + git; it's an unverified dev build (the dashboard compile wants real RAM/CPU) — not a production path.
sents.zh: 需要 Bun 和 git；这是一个未经校验的开发版本（仪表盘编译需要足够的内存和 CPU 性能）——并非生产环境方案。

paragraphs.en: cd your-project openship init # link this directory to a project openship deploy Full server guide + complete CLI reference: openship.io/docs .
paragraphs.zh: cd your-project openship init # 将此目录链接到一个项目 openship deploy 完整的服务器指南与 CLI 完整参考：openship.io/docs。

paragraphs.en: Two ways to enable Tab-completion for openship :
paragraphs.zh: 为 openship 启用 Tab 补全的两种方式：

paragraphs.en: openship completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/openship openship completion zsh > ~ /.zsh/completions/_openship openship completion fish > ~ /.config/fish/completions/openship.fish Open a new terminal — done.
paragraphs.zh: openship completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/openship openship completion zsh > ~ /.zsh/completions/_openship openship completion fish > ~ /.config/fish/completions/openship.fish 打开一个新的终端 —— 完成。

paragraphs.en: echo ' source <(openship completion zsh) ' >> ~ /.zshrc Self-host with raw Docker Compose (no CLI) The self-hosted stack lives in docker/docker-compose.yml and pulls published images from GitHub Container Registry ( ghcr.io/oblien/* ) — no build tooling, no monorepo compile. Run it from the repo root:
paragraphs.zh: echo ' source <(openship completion zsh) ' >> ~ /.zshrc 使用原始 Docker Compose 自托管（无需 CLI）自托管堆栈位于 docker/docker-compose.yml 中，并从 GitHub Container Registry（ ghcr.io/oblien/* ）拉取已发布的镜像——无需构建工具，无需 monorepo 编译。 从仓库根目录运行：

sents.en: echo ' source <(openship completion zsh) ' >> ~ /.zshrc Self-host with raw Docker Compose (no CLI) The self-hosted stack lives in docker/docker-compose.yml and pulls published images from GitHub Container Registry ( ghcr.io/oblien/* ) — no build tooling, no monorepo compile.
sents.zh: echo ' source <(openship completion zsh) ' >> ~ /.zshrc 使用原始 Docker Compose 自托管（无需 CLI）自托管堆栈位于 docker/docker-compose.yml 中，并从 GitHub Container Registry（ ghcr.io/oblien/* ）拉取已发布的镜像——无需构建工具，无需 monorepo 编译。

sents.en: Run it from the repo root:
sents.zh: 从仓库根目录运行：

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/oblien/openship.git && cd openship cp .env.example .env # then edit docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d The stack is postgres + redis + api + dashboard + edge . The edge is OpenResty on :80/:443 as a container ( network_mode: host ) — routing + Let's Encrypt, no bare host install. Linux only (host networking); on mac/win use openship up (bare). The api container mounts the host Docker socket so the control plane can build + run your apps as host containers — it's host-privileged through the socket, so run it only on a trusted host.
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/oblien/openship.git && cd openship cp .env.example .env # 然后编辑 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d 该技术栈为 postgres + redis + api + dashboard + edge。 edge 是一个以容器形式运行的 OpenResty（network_mode: host），监听 :80/:443 —— 负责路由和 Let's Encrypt，无需在宿主机上直接安装。 仅支持 Linux（宿主机网络模式）；在 mac/win 上请使用 openship up（裸机模式）。 api 容器会挂载宿主机的 Docker socket，以便控制平面能够以宿主机容器的形式构建并运行你的应用 —— 通过 socket 它拥有宿主机级别的权限，因此只应在可信的宿主机上运行。

sents.en: git clone https://github.com/oblien/openship.git && cd openship cp .env.example .env # then edit docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d The stack is postgres + redis + api + dashboard + edge .
sents.zh: git clone https://github.com/oblien/openship.git && cd openship cp .env.example .env # 然后编辑 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d 该技术栈为 postgres + redis + api + dashboard + edge。

sents.en: The edge is OpenResty on :80/:443 as a container ( network_mode: host ) — routing + Let's Encrypt, no bare host install.
sents.zh: edge 是一个以容器形式运行的 OpenResty（network_mode: host），监听 :80/:443 —— 负责路由和 Let's Encrypt，无需在宿主机上直接安装。

sents.en: Linux only (host networking); on mac/win use openship up (bare).
sents.zh: 仅支持 Linux（宿主机网络模式）；在 mac/win 上请使用 openship up（裸机模式）。

sents.en: The api container mounts the host Docker socket so the control plane can build + run your apps as host containers — it's host-privileged through the socket, so run it only on a trusted host.
sents.zh: api 容器会挂载宿主机的 Docker socket，以便控制平面能够以宿主机容器的形式构建并运行你的应用 —— 通过 socket 它拥有宿主机级别的权限，因此只应在可信的宿主机上运行。

paragraphs.en: Upgrade: pin OPENSHIP_VERSION in .env for reproducible pulls, then docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml pull && … up -d . openship update only reconciles a stack the CLI installed, and openship up would adopt this one — don't reach for either here. Build from source instead: add -f docker/docker-compose.build.yml … up -d --build .
paragraphs.zh: 升级：在 .env 中固定 OPENSHIP_VERSION 以实现可复现的拉取，然后运行 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml pull && … up -d。openship update 只会协调（reconcile）由 CLI 安装的堆栈，而 openship up 会接管这一个——所以这里不要用这两者中的任何一个。 改为从源码构建：添加 -f docker/docker-compose.build.yml … up -d --build。

sents.en: Upgrade: pin OPENSHIP_VERSION in .env for reproducible pulls, then docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml pull && … up -d . openship update only reconciles a stack the CLI installed, and openship up would adopt this one — don't reach for either here.
sents.zh: 升级：在 .env 中固定 OPENSHIP_VERSION 以实现可复现的拉取，然后运行 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml pull && … up -d。openship update 只会协调（reconcile）由 CLI 安装的堆栈，而 openship up 会接管这一个——所以这里不要用这两者中的任何一个。

sents.en: Build from source instead: add -f docker/docker-compose.build.yml … up -d --build .
sents.zh: 改为从源码构建：添加 -f docker/docker-compose.build.yml … up -d --build。

paragraphs.en: Host operations ( :80 / :443 takeover, the mail engine, host terminal/port scans) need the container→host SSH channel, which openship up provisions and this path does not — the five manual steps are in .env.example under Host operations from the container , and the failure it produces is Troubleshooting → Host control channel . Everything else, including deploys, works without it.
paragraphs.zh: 主机操作（:80 / :443 接管、邮件引擎、主机终端/端口扫描）需要容器→主机的 SSH 通道，openship up 负责预置而此路径没有——五个手动步骤在 .env.example 的 Host operations from the container 一节中，它产生的故障见 Troubleshooting → Host control channel。 其他所有操作（包括部署）在没有它的情况下也能正常工作。

sents.en: Host operations ( :80 / :443 takeover, the mail engine, host terminal/port scans) need the container→host SSH channel, which openship up provisions and this path does not — the five manual steps are in .env.example under Host operations from the container , and the failure it produces is Troubleshooting → Host control channel .
sents.zh: 主机操作（:80 / :443 接管、邮件引擎、主机终端/端口扫描）需要容器→主机的 SSH 通道，openship up 负责预置而此路径没有——五个手动步骤在 .env.example 的 Host operations from the container 一节中，它产生的故障见 Troubleshooting → Host control channel。

sents.en: Everything else, including deploys, works without it.
sents.zh: 其他所有操作（包括部署）在没有它的情况下也能正常工作。

paragraphs.en: The root docker-compose.yml is a different file: it's the SaaS / from-source control plane (builds from source, ships the marketing site, no edge/socket). It does not self-host your apps — use docker/docker-compose.yml above or openship up .
paragraphs.zh: 根目录的 docker-compose.yml 是另一个不同的文件：它是 SaaS / 从源码运行的控制平面（从源码构建，附带营销网站，不含 edge/socket）。 它不会自托管你的应用——请使用上面的 docker/docker-compose.yml 或 openship up。

sents.en: The root docker-compose.yml is a different file: it's the SaaS / from-source control plane (builds from source, ships the marketing site, no edge/socket).
sents.zh: 根目录的 docker-compose.yml 是另一个不同的文件：它是 SaaS / 从源码运行的控制平面（从源码构建，附带营销网站，不含 edge/socket）。

sents.en: It does not self-host your apps — use docker/docker-compose.yml above or openship up .
sents.zh: 它不会自托管你的应用——请使用上面的 docker/docker-compose.yml 或 openship up。

paragraphs.en: Point Openship at a source — a GitHub repo , a local folder , or a prebuilt artifact — and it runs one pipeline end to end:
paragraphs.zh: 将 Point 指向一个源——一个 GitHub 仓库、一个本地文件夹或一个预构建产物——它就会端到端地运行一条流水线：

paragraphs.en: Databases, domains, SSL, CDN, mail, and backups are managed from the same place. (Push-to-deploy and public domains need an always-on server or Cloud — a desktop/loopback instance has no public endpoint to receive webhooks.)
paragraphs.zh: 数据库、域名、SSL、CDN、邮件和备份都在同一个地方管理。 （推送部署和公网域名需要一台始终在线的服务器或云服务——桌面/回环实例没有可用于接收 webhook 的公网端点。）

sents.en: Databases, domains, SSL, CDN, mail, and backups are managed from the same place.
sents.zh: 数据库、域名、SSL、CDN、邮件和备份都在同一个地方管理。

sents.en: (Push-to-deploy and public domains need an always-on server or Cloud — a desktop/loopback instance has no public endpoint to receive webhooks.)
sents.zh: （推送部署和公网域名需要一台始终在线的服务器或云服务——桌面/回环实例没有可用于接收 webhook 的公网端点。）

paragraphs.en: An MCP endpoint (for AI agents) and a REST API round it out for automation. Only routes that opt in are exposed as MCP tools, every call re-checks your permissions, and credential/token routes can never become tools. Full reference at openship.io/docs .
paragraphs.zh: 此外还提供面向 AI 智能体的 MCP 端点和 REST API，以便实现自动化。 只有选择加入的路由才会作为 MCP 工具暴露，每次调用都会重新检查你的权限，且凭证/令牌路由绝不能成为工具。 完整参考文档见 openship.io/docs。

paragraphs.en: Production-ready core, actively developed. Self-hosting is free (no billing).
paragraphs.zh: 可用于生产环境的核心功能，持续活跃开发中。 自托管免费（无需付费）。

paragraphs.en: Coming next: multi-node clusters, load-balancing UI, private networking, advanced monitoring, and visual CI/CD pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 即将推出：多节点集群、负载均衡界面、私有网络、高级监控以及可视化 CI/CD 流水线。

paragraphs.en: Found a vulnerability? We welcome your report — please disclose it privately , never in a public issue, PR, or discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 发现了漏洞？ 我们欢迎你提交报告——请私下披露，切勿在公开的 issue、PR 或讨论中披露。

sents.en: Found a vulnerability?
sents.zh: 发现了漏洞？

sents.en: We welcome your report — please disclose it privately , never in a public issue, PR, or discussion.
sents.zh: 我们欢迎你提交报告——请私下披露，切勿在公开的 issue、PR 或讨论中披露。

paragraphs.en: Good-faith security research is authorized under our safe-harbor policy , and we're happy to credit valid first reports.
paragraphs.zh: 善意安全研究在我们安全港政策的授权范围内，我们也很乐意为有效的首发报告署名致谢。
